why: The bound, pinned rather than left implicit. The evidence window is 2,500 characters of a source item, not the whole of an arbitrarily long one, so support far enough from the citation is still out of view and the claim is still refused. That is a deliberate residue of the fix and not an oversight: an unbounded window would make one call carry a whole article and would put every claim of a long story on a call of its own. If this case ever flips to supported, the budget moved and the cost of the grounding stage moved with it.
